description: List the Valet organizations the account belongs to, sorted by name, with the one every tool uses when you omit org_name marked as the default. Each organization shows your role in it (admin or developer), its member count, and its pending invitation count. Pass include with members, invitations, or both to also list the members (email, name, role, and when they joined) and the pending invitations (email, when sent, and when they expire). Pass org_name to list one organization. Use the names here as org_name on the other tools. Invitation codes are never shown. Requires connecting a Valet account.

include.description: Detail to add for each organization: members adds who belongs to it and their roles, invitations adds who has been invited. Omit for counts only.

org_name.description: List only this Valet organization. Omit to list every organization the account belongs to.

name: list_orgs

orgs.description: The organizations the account belongs to, sorted by name.

created.description: RFC 3339 time the organization was created.

default.description: True for the organization every tool uses when org_name is omitted.

invitation_count.description: Total pending invitations. Zero when members_hidden is true.

invitations.description: Pending invitations, at most the first 100. Present only when include names invitations and members_hidden is false.

created.description: RFC 3339 time the invitation was sent.

email.description: Email address the invitation was sent to.

member_count.description: Total members. Zero when members_hidden is true.

members.description: Members, at most the first 100. Present only when include names members and members_hidden is false.

joined.description: RFC 3339 time the member joined the organization.

name.description: The member's first and last name. Absent when they have none.

role.description: The member's role in the organization, such as admin or developer. Absent for a member with no role binding; do not read that as a grant.

members_hidden.description: True when the account's role may not list this organization's members and invitations, so both lists are empty and both counts are zero.

name.description: Organization name. Pass it as org_name to the other tools.

role.description: The account's role in this organization, such as admin or developer. Absent when the account holds none.

truncated.description: True when members or invitations held more than 100 entries and the list was cut to the first 100. Compare the counts to the list lengths.

title: List organizations
